description: Dry-run a watch config BEFORE creating it — render the proposed config once and report what was captured + whether the page is reachable (and the text a text-watch would compare). Creates no watch, no baseline, no diff. Use this to validate a selector/scope/identity first. Returns JSON.

aiSummary.description: Pro+ — attach a one-sentence AI 'what changed' summary to each detected change.

diffMode.description: How changes are detected. Default 'both' = a pixel diff (with a highlighted overlay) AND a FULL-PAGE text diff, alerting on either — catches any change, visual or text. 'visual' or 'text' narrow to one signal only.

intervalMinutes.description: Check frequency in minutes. Minimum is your plan's floor — Free 1440 (daily), Starter 180, Pro 30, Enterprise 5.

notifyEmail.description: Any plan — send change alerts here. Must be your OWN account email (others are rejected). Defaults to it if omitted.

paused.description: Create the watch paused (no baseline capture or charge until resumed).

renderParams.description: Render knobs applied on every check (a subset of the screenshot capture params).

blockCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie/consent banners before capture.

device.description: Device preset (viewport + scale + UA). E.g. 'iphone_15' to monitor the mobile layout.

format.description: Capture format. A pdf cannot be visually diffed — pair it with diffMode 'text'. Default png.

fullPage.description: Monitor the whole scrollable page (default true for watches). Set false to watch only the viewport.

geo.description: Pro+ — ISO country code to render from. VISUAL-ONLY: cannot combine with a 'text' OR 'both' diffMode (a geo render returns no extracted text).

geoCity.description: City for more precise geo-targeting (requires geo).

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors to hide before capture (max 50).

ignoreRegions.description: Pixel rectangles masked in both captures before the visual diff — silence dynamic zones (ad slot, clock). Visual mode only.

ignoreText.description: Substrings or /regex/flags stripped from both texts before the text diff — silence timestamps, counters, tokens.

minTextChars.description: Minimum added + removed characters for a text change to count (ignore tiny edits).

selector.description: Capture and diff ONLY this CSS element — watch one price/banner/section instead of the whole page.

suppressWhilePresent.description: While the page text contains any of these markers (e.g. 'Out of stock'), treat the run as unchanged.

uaMode.description: User-Agent identity: auto (identify then fall back), identify (always RendexWatch), stealth (always a standard browser). See https://rendex.dev/bot

threshold.description: Visual sensitivity (0..1). Low (default 0.01) alerts on ANY change, including a small one on a long page (a changed-region test, not a whole-page pixel ratio). 0.06+ = only MAJOR visual changes (whole-page ratio). Text detection is unaffected.

url.description: The page to monitor (a schemeless host like 'rendex.dev/pricing' is upgraded to https).

name: watch_test
title: Test Watch Config (dry-run)
